segments.text:
V. 8.
So they did eat—This Miracle was intended to demonſtrate, that Chriſt was the true Bread which cometh down from Heaven; for He who was Almighty to create Bread without Means to ſupport natural Life, could not want Power to create Bread without Means to ſupport ſpiritual Life. And this heavenly Bread we ſtand ſo much in need of every Moment, that we ought to be always praying, LORD, evermore give us this Bread.
